# Fuel Moisture Content

::: {.page-subtitle}
**Random Forest · Sentinel-2 · Data Cube Chile**
:::

Estimation of Fuel Moisture Content (FMC) from Sentinel-2 imagery using a pretrained Random Forest model, adapted to vegetation in a Chilean national park.

![FMC at the start of the fire season versus its peak in late summer](/images/fmc-seasonal-comparison.png)

![Monthly average FMC across Parque Nacional Río Clarillo, 2024](/images/fmc-monthly-timeseries.png)

### Methodology

- Sentinel-2 imagery with cloud, shadow, and water masking
- NDVI and NDII calculation
- Pixel-level FMC estimation using a pretrained Random Forest model
- Monthly and seasonal FMC analysis for Parque Nacional Río Clarillo

### Results

The workflow captured the expected seasonal pattern of Mediterranean vegetation, with **lower FMC during late summer and recovery following winter rainfall**.

The model was originally trained on Australian vegetation and adapted for application in Chile, providing an approach for FMC estimation where no ready-made national product was available.
